### May the God of Peace
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/may-god-peace
Passage: Hebrews 13:20
Points:
- The closing benediction in Hebrews reflects traditional Jewish blessings and affirms the author's scriptural background.
- Emphasizing Jesus as the Great Shepherd reassures Christians of the absolute security of their salvation.
- Christ exercises His roles as prophet, priest, and king by instructing His flock, shedding covenant blood, and preserving His people.
- Believers can take comfort in prayer, knowing the resurrected Shepherd will never let any of His sheep be lost.
